mainland_dependency_context: Pure mainland G. henryi is source-supported as exclusively Bombus diversus pollinated in the focal system.
island_comparison: On Kozu all specimens initially identified as G. henryi were G. henryi x G. similis hybrids; pure G. henryi was not recovered; hybrids use the G. similis scoliid-wasp interaction.
claim_boundary: Pure-lineage failure on Kozu is compatible with strong filtering but does not isolate pollinator causation from habitat dispersal or historical factors.

mainland_dependency_context: Mainland C. aristulifera is reported in the source literature as thought to be exclusively pollinated by the relatively large bee Eucera nipponensis.
island_comparison: Mikura lacks Bombus and Eucera; interval photography recorded Lasioglossum occidens carrying pollinaria, identifying a plausible small-bee pollination route without requiring disappearance of the pure plant lineage.
claim_boundary: The island observation demonstrates a plausible effective small-bee interaction but does not prove that mainland exclusive dependence was universal or that pollinator absence caused any morphological evolution.

mainland_dependency_context: Mainland/widespread Calanthe lineages are associated with larger-bee pollination context.
island_comparison: Across investigated Izu islands, relatively small solitary bees are proposed to mediate pollination/hybridization; floral morphologies change with remoteness and natural hybridization occurs.
claim_boundary: Morphology and hybridization covary with island context; the source does not make a clean Oshima-to-post Bombus-boundary experiment.

mainland_dependency_context: Mainland predominant pollinator is Bombus diversus; Oshima has Bombus ardens plus halictids.
island_comparison: Southern Izu populations persist with halictid-dominated pollination, smaller flowers and source-locked breeding-system/autonomous-reproduction changes.
claim_boundary: Persistence with altered interaction and breeding channels is focal calibration; taxonomy/population history and environment remain competing explanations for continuous responses.

mainland_dependency_context: The primary source labels the pollination system generalist.
island_comparison: Izu populations persist and show shorter corolla tubes/stamens, strongest on Hachijo, with geographically differing pollinator fauna.
claim_boundary: Generalist persistence does not imply morphological stasis; exact breakpoint and numeric effect remain unavailable from the current public source route.
